sections.Profile:
"Teed Off," released by Gottlieb in May 1993, is a golf-themed pinball machine designed by Jon Norris and Ray Tanzer. It features a whimsical take on the sport with a playful gopher character reminiscent of "Caddyshack".

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1993
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: DMD
- Players: 4
- Tags: Golf, Sports, 1990s, Solid State
